name: week
title: Weekly assortment review
subtitle: Fictional demo until your own reports are imported. Compare like reporting windows and currencies.

sections.title: Work needing attention
sections.sql: select store_code,kind,item,owner,due_on from assortment_attention order by store_code,kind

sections.title: Category performance
sections.sql: select store_code,category,period_start::text || ' to ' || period_end::text reporting_window,currency,sales_amount,gross_margin_amount,missing_costs from category_performance order by store_code,category
sections.note: Missing cost means margin is unknown. Store windows remain separate.

sections.title: Range gaps
sections.sql: select store_code,sku,product,issue from assortment_gaps order by store_code,sku

sections.title: Unit-price evidence review
sections.sql: select store_code,sku,rule,finding from assortment_compliance order by store_code,sku
sections.note: Evidence completeness checks only. They do not inspect a shelf or certify compliance.

sections.title: Sales and facings
sections.sql: select store_code,sku,product,period_start,period_end,currency,facings,width_mm,sales_per_facing_amount,sales_per_metre_amount from range_performance order by store_code,sku
sections.note: Linear width only. This is a review of reported facings, not a physical planogram or an optimisation.
